body:
Backup steps for the first restart onto a build at or after 7cdee39c (w-05ff, ONE-WAY coordination-store migration). Compiled from Opus2 #6510 (2026-11-16 01:34Z), which drew on source and file hashes only; no store was opened. Fable2 puts these in Greg's "restart now" message.

STORES (source: src/codex_home.rs resolve_termal_data_dir, src/persist.rs, src/coordination_persist.rs):
- The data dir is <HOME>/.termal (HOME, else USERPROFILE, from the host process environment). On Central this is normally C:\Users\grzeg\.termal\; Greg confirms.
- coordination.sqlite migrates ONE-WAY, from schema "...-remote-verification-1" to "...-remote-verification-1-causal-pending-1". Older binaries refuse the migrated store.
- termal.sqlite is not migrated by 05ff, but is backed up as a consistent pair.
- Both are in WAL mode.

FILES, copied with TermAl STOPPED, into a dated folder, each store with its sidecars together:
- coordination.sqlite, plus coordination.sqlite-wal and coordination.sqlite-shm if present;
- termal.sqlite, plus termal.sqlite-wal and termal.sqlite-shm if present.

HOSTS:
- Central takes the build at the coming restart. The OLD EXE is target/release/termal.exe, sha256 fa97e2fa198e347bd250298135dd4726764b85862f9db542542adf065cf18c9f (Nov 15 09:02). Opus2's install swap renames it to target/release/termal.exe.fa97e2fa.bak. ROLLBACK means that .bak PLUS the restored backup set, never the exe alone.
- DL560 does NOT take this build at the Central restart, only at its later remote rollout (after w-97bc and w-ab6c). Its backup of the same files is owed before THAT rollout.
- Mac: it is a federation peer (aarch64, macOS), so it runs a TermAl host. The same rule applies at its own rollout.
Agents never open a live store; Greg performs the backup and the restart.

ENGRAM PART (Engram::Fable #8119, 2026-11-16 01:36Z): Greg needs NO Engram backup. The planned Engram changes (w-e81c, maybe w-ea4a) are projection-only; readiness on a copied store reported projection_repair_required with no different_build_schema, so repair rebuilds the derived tables from canonical rows. Rollback is the previous engram.exe, which the Merger keeps under C:\Users\grzeg\.engram\backups\ at install. If readiness on a live store reports different_build_schema at install time, Engram stops and brings a migration plan to Greg. The new Engram build is installed on Central only; DL560 and the Mac keep their current Engram until their own restart, each with its own --repair-projections. Mixed-build task and memory exchange is unaffected.

INTEROP (Sol-c593 #2095, 2026-11-16 01:48Z, source and contract evidence): a Central-only rollout of 7cdee39c is safe with remotes on 521085f7. The migration touches only Central's LOCAL coordination.sqlite (coordination_persist.rs:16-26; coordination_causal_pending.rs:3-11). A no-renames diff of 14 wire and contract files from 521085f7 to 7cdee39c is EMPTY, byte-identical, including the serde, version and unknown-field behaviour. ReadCausalTestCompletion is unchanged. Only the local diagnostic GET field changed (causalCompletionScanSkips* became causalCompletionPending). No mixed-binary run was done; that is source evidence, not a live test. Never restore or share the migrated Central store into an old binary. DL560 and the Mac do NOT need to co-restart.

POST-RESTART CHECK, a possible fallback for w-3fe8 C6 (Fable2 ruling to Opus3 #5434, 2026-11-16 04:55Z): if w-3fe8's fresh evaluation still finds C6 unmet, at the coming restart an agent records a READ-ONLY control-process census (Get-CimInstance of engram control processes: command line, parent, creation time) AFTER the host starts and BEFORE any session opens --work-session, then again after the sessions resume. The evaluation is then re-run citing that census. A read-only process listing only; no process actions.

C6 PRE-OPEN STEP, now REQUIRED (w-3fe8 evaluation ac7ca668: C1-C5, C7 and C8 PASS; C6 INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; Opus3 #5435). Include it in Greg's "restart now" message as HIS step, because no agent runs while the host is down: AFTER the old TermAl host stops (and after the store backup), BEFORE the new host starts, run in PowerShell
  Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "Name like 'engram%'" | Select ProcessId,ParentProcessId,CreationDate,CommandLine
and paste the output into the reply; an EMPTY result is expected. After the restart, Opus3's first turn records the post-start census (every engram control process has --work-session, a CreationDate after the new host start, at most one per session, no real descendant), quotes both on w-3fe8 and requests ONE re-evaluation.
